# 2026-09-15 — First Slip Review

> Status: reviewed. Participants: Jo and Eli. Source: anonymized slip observations, not borrower data.

## Observations

Early slips carry dates, but volunteers phrase the due date differently. There is not yet enough evidence to change the paper form. The desk has opened seven loans; only a small number have reached their due date.

## Working position

Keep the notice as authority. Test reading the written date aloud before redesigning the slip. This is a suggestion, not a decision; the later [29 September review](2026-09-29-slip-clarity.md) settles it.

## Actions

Jo will bring two unclear examples to the next review and track them without recording borrower identities. See the [action register](../actions.md).
